description: MMS gate: run the inline esm-spec 6.6 tests of problems/advection_2d_x_dirichlet_central.esm (model Advection2DxDirichlet, test mms_x_dirichlet_decay) at the problem's default resolution (NX=64, NY edge-bound to 8) through each binding's official simulation pathway. Exercises the second-order centered fixed-value (Dirichlet) first-derivative rule central_D1x_dirichlet_bc (mirror-ghost x-face columns, nonzero walls gL=1, gR=e^2) as the advective x-term of a well-posed advection-diffusion decay problem on the full 2-D field. The assertions and their tolerances live in the problem file itself; this manifest only routes the runners.

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
